title: BO-000004 guard: a chitchat proposal whose stated total disagrees with what was extracted is never saved or shown
notes: End-to-end reproduction of the real production bug (order BO-000004): an empty-cart, non-order-intent customer message gets a chitchat reply from the LLM describing an elaborate, fabricated order (a combo plus an invented item) with a stated total that does not match what _extract_items_from_message actually resolves from that same text. Before the fix, this fabricated summary was shown verbatim to the customer and the mismatched fragments were silently saved as proposed_items, ready to commit on the next 'Yes'. After the fix (pipeline.py's proposed-order-capture block, see KNOWN_BUGS.md BUG-0151), the stated-total-vs-extracted-sum mismatch is caught and the fabricated text is never shown or saved -- the customer gets a plain clarification request instead, and the cart stays empty.
